voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Uses sodium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.hide_unrefined_lod.t: Hide LOD cells whose finest-detail mesh has not yet streamed in, instead of showing the coarser parent. Trades visible progressive refinement for visible holes during streaming.
voxy.config.distantgen.enabled.tooltip: When enabled, voxy will continuously generate and LOD chunks outside Minecraft's render distance up to the configured radius. Runs in all loaded dimensions (overworld, nether, end, modded). Master toggle: turning off freezes new distant-gen work; existing LODs remain visible.
voxy.config.distantgen.radius.tooltip: Maximum chunk distance from each player out to which distant generation will fill. Independent of voxy's render radius and Minecraft's render distance. Larger values generate further but take much longer to complete.
voxy.config.distantgen.threads.tooltip: Maximum number of chunks being generated concurrently per dimension. Higher values speed up fill rate but increase server-tick impact. Recommended: 2 for steady background fill on most systems. Empirically, values above 4 noticeably impact tick time even when chunks are already on disk.
voxy.config.distantgen.verbose_logging.t: Emits per-chunk INFO logs at every phase of distant-gen processing. Useful for diagnosing where chunks are getting stuck. Very verbose: leave off unless you need it. Heartbeat with counters always runs regardless.
